title: Niels W NDE 9193
content: I must have been three or four years old when I underwent an eye surgery to correct the vision in one of my eyes. Before the surgery, I met with a priest who prayed with me because I was frightened of the surgery. During the surgery I underwent anesthesia and all was well until I felt my chest hurting. I thought to myself, 'Won’t the pain end? Won’t someone please help me? God, help me, when will this end?' I was then suddenly rocketed out of my body and I could see myself on the surgery table. The doctors were all scrambling and I thought to myself, 'Why are they acting like that? I feel great.' I was then pulled upwards from my body. I thought, 'Well I guess this is it, good-bye body.' I was then taken into a tunnel by an individual made of light. I had seen the individual before the anesthesia was given to me. When I first saw this being, I thought, 'Who are you?' No answer came at that time. Nor did an answer come while I was led through the tube of light. Then, I was inside a void with the mysterious being. I asked this being, 'Who are you?' And the being said, 'Who do you want me to be?' The being then took on my mother’s voice and said, 'I can use this voice if it makes you comfortable.' When I declined, the being switched voices again and talked in my deceased grandfather’s voice. I felt more at ease then. I was given a life review while inside the void. During this review, I told the being to pause. I wanted to better examine the parts of my life. I was then able to view these events from overhead. The life review did not last long because I asked the being something that surprised it. 'Can I plan my next reincarnation?' I asked. The being said, 'Usually people wait until their actual death to choose their reincarnation.' I was persistent, because I already knew where I wanted to go: Japan. I was then taken to Japan via an overhead view. The being and I looked at various cities until we reached Numero in Hokkaido. I told the being that I wanted to be reincarnated here. Then, I was given a temporary glimpse into my next life. All I remember about this part was that I was Male and was wearing a dark colored coat that was accented by stylish autumn scarf while I stood in front of the train station. Then, I returned to the void. I was suddenly dragged back into my body as the doctors restarted my heart. The revival soon failed and I was pushed back into the void. I was back with the being. The being asked me multiple questions during the reincarnation conversation and will allow me to be autistic during my next life as well. Near the end of the conversation I asked, 'Wait, can I see my grandfather?' And the being said, 'Not yet.' For the sake of my mother, I returned permanently to my body. After the surgery I thought to myself, 'I saw an angel!' But did not speak about it to my parents. I strongly believe that I will be reincarnated in Hokkaido during my next life. I believe our souls get some choice during the death process. Some additional things about the experience: I was informed that I would develop mental illness during my twenties. So far this has been correct. I am typing this out during my most logical moments because I fully believe that this event will occur and that I will be reincarnated after I die. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 1995 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related Out of body experience. I was in retina surgery and my heart stopped twice during the surgery. How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes Went to visit Japan from an aerial view. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. My consciousness was greatly enhanced. I was aware that the doctors were attempting to restart my heart. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? After my heart had stopped the first time. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Extremely heightened vision. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. No comment, because I cannot recall. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes The tunnel was grey and had a light at the end that kept getting brighter and brighter. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes The light was extremely bright but was not painful. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt fear before exiting my body and peace after exiting my body. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control. My life flashed before me and I saw everything very quickly. Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future. I learned that I would have two mental illnesses later during my twenties. Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. My mother would have been saddened by my death. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Do not know Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Due to mental illness, I no longer adhere to one religion. What is your religion now? No comment Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. I encountered a luminous being of unearthly origin. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes Caught a momentary glimpse of my next life. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Uncertain. I am unsure what the being was that was with me. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife probably exists. Directly asked the being to be reincarnated at a specific place. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes. I chose my mental condition prior to coming here. During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain. I was a child at the time. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I believe the experience happened to prepare me for things that would occur during my adult life. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. I firmly believe that this occurred. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes 'No contact whatsoever'

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt fear before exiting body and peace after exiting; 'I feel great.'

arrival.other_being_detail: An 'individual made of light' that could change its voice (mother’s voice; deceased grandfather’s voice).

environment.environment_other_detail: Described being 'inside a void' with the being; also described a grey tunnel with a brightening light at the end.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Dragged back into body as doctors restarted heart; revival failed and he was 'pushed back into the void'; later returned permanently.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Retina/eye surgery under anesthesia; heart stopped twice during surgery.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Void experience; reincarnation planning conversation; aerial viewing of Japan; temporary glimpse of next life; repeated return/void sequence when heart stopped twice.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE → tunnel/tube of light with being → void → brief life review → reincarnation planning/aerial travel and next-life glimpse → return to body → back to void when revival failed → final return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to body when heart restarted; then pushed back into void when revival failed; later returned permanently.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Asked to 'plan my next reincarnation' during the NDE; being replied that people 'usually' wait until actual death. Aerial travel to Japan and selection of a specific reincarnation location (Hokkaido). Brief preview of next life (male wearing dark coat and autumn scarf at a train station). Heart stopped twice causing a return-to-body then back-to-void sequence.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was then suddenly rocketed out of my body and I could see myself on the surgery table."; "Well I guess this is it, good-bye body."; "Who are you?" / "Who do you want me to be?"; "Usually people wait until their actual death to choose their reincarnation."; "Not yet."; "I saw an angel!"; "No contact whatsoever"
